description: Welcome to the official website for the campaign to Re-Elect Tim Wadsworth to the Alabama House of Representatives! Here, you can learn more about Tim's commitment to serving House District 14, which includes most of Winston and portions of Cullman, Jefferson, and Walker counties in Alabama.
